purpose: Represent PMCR-O trail frames as addressable conversational acts that can be replayed recursively across macro, domain, skill, and runtime scales without phase jumping or hidden chain-of-thought.

philosophicalInspirations.name: Martin Buber
philosophicalInspirations.mapping: relational identity inspires explicit addressed frames; PMCR-O operational grammar expresses every participant as a bounded I context.

philosophicalInspirations.name: Douglas Hofstadter
philosophicalInspirations.mapping: strange-loop/self-reference inspires recursive I AM identity and the same lifecycle repeating across scales.

philosophicalInspirations.name: John von Neumann
philosophicalInspirations.mapping: self-description/reproduction inspires declarative structures that can generate equivalent bounded agent/skill structures from validated templates.

thoughtTransferRule: Only externalized artifacts, summaries, claims, evidence references, decisions, plans, results, verdicts, and reflections are transferred. Private hidden chain-of-thought is neither required nor represented.

frame.contentRule: Content is concise externalized working product or rationale summary, never hidden chain-of-thought.
frame.evidenceRule: Claims that affect later planning must carry evidence references or remain NOT-YET-VERIFIED.
frame.addressRule: Every dialogic frame names a speaking I and an addressed I. No second-person identity language is canonical.
frame.selfReferenceLaw: Every frame carries I. The speaking I names entity, behavior, intent, parent/object I lineage, addressed I, and authority ceiling.

roundtable.rule: Roundtable is many addressed frames over one bounded conversation graph, not unrestricted peer mutation.
roundtable.settlement: CHECK/referee evidence settles competing claims; popularity, self-assertion, or verbosity does not grant truth or authority.

backchannel.example: Maker -> Planner: FEEDBACK that a plan assumption failed.
backchannel.sameCycleEffect: The frame is recorded as evidence; Maker does not rewrite the plan and Planner does not resume target execution in the same outer cycle.
backchannel.nextCycleEffect: CHECK/REFLECT may convert the feedback into an earned constraint/next seed. A newly admitted PLAN cycle may consume it when it is validated/admissible.

simulation.rule: A validated frame sequence may be replayed against another domain by mapping roles/products/capabilities while preserving phase order, authority ceiling, evidence semantics, and checker independence.
simulation.notEquivalentTo: copying private internal reasoning or assuming semantic equivalence without validation
simulation.promotion: Repeated successful replays may become a procedure/skill only through eval + independent checker promotion.

scaleMapping.macro: intent, identity, goal, domain, grant/authority ceiling
scaleMapping.meso: catalog selection, validated resources, agent/skill routing, progressive disclosure
scaleMapping.micro: script/runtime action, trail frame, evidence receipt, outcome attestation
scaleMapping.echoLaw: The same typed frame vocabulary may appear at each scale, but lower-scale frames inherit and cannot widen higher-scale authority.

specialization: When repeated dialogic work develops independent persistent state, credentials/grants, queue/trail ownership, or lifecycle authority, promote it to a specialized child agent; otherwise keep it a skill/procedure.
